sloka: दातुमिच्छति तस्मै तु तच्छ्रुत्वा बलदर्पितः ।दम्भुर्नाम ततो राजा दैत्यानां कुपितो ऽभवत् ।। ७.१७.१३ ॥
transliteration: dātumicchati tasmai tu tacchrutvā baladarpitaḥ ।dambhurnāma tato rājā daityānāṁ kupito 'bhavat ।। 7.17.13 ॥

translations.english: My father indeed desired Vishnu, the lord of gods and the lord of the three worlds, to be his son-in-law, and therefore he would not give me to anyone else.
